legend: Anteroposterior (shown here) and lateral (Fig. <<55029>>) radiographs of the right tibia and fibula in a patient with chronic renal failure. Multiple lucent foci are seen in both bones. In the distal tibia, an extensive lobular lesion has breached the lateral cortex and contains fine strands of ossification.

Anteroposterior (Fig. <<55028>>) and lateral (shown here) radiographs of the right tibia and fibula in a patient with chronic renal failure. Multiple lucent foci are seen in both bones. In the distal tibia, an extensive lobular lesion has breached the lateral cortex and contains fine strands of ossification.
Low-power view shows a polylobulated spindle cell proliferation with haemorrhage and intermingled osteoclastic giant cells.
Higher magnification reveals monomorphic, fibroblast-like spindle cells lacking cytological atypia, and multinucleated giant cells.
The tumour shows a mixture of monomorphic and cytologically bland spindle cells and osteoclastic giant cells associated with hemorrhage and siderophages.
